summary: request.TDDBuild parses the _test.go files of go/acs/cycle<N> in the worktree to list the predicates for the build prompt. A FIFO there hangs seedTaskContract before the build phase with no timeout (D1). A symlinked _test.go sends the first token of a hidden file into the build prompt (D2; the go test -list note path had the same leak before H9). core.ReadHandoffLedger reads with io.ReadAll and no size cap (D3).
title: The tdd-build request reads ACS test files through the plain-file reader, and the ledger read has a size cap
